refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoMathSin calculates the sine of argv[0] in radians.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoMathSin returns a pointer to an object representing the result of the sine function. If argc is not 1, the returned value will be an error value with value SilikoErrorFunctionArguments.

refsection.title: Conformance
refsection.para: The SilikoMathSin function conforms to SilikoCore’s interface for pure functions and can be installed into a SilikoEngine if wrapped with SilikoPureFunctionCreate.
